verdict.rationale: Sprinto ships AI features (an AI Editor for ingestion workflows and AI evidence gap analysis), so it is fair to ask whether it can act as an MCP client. However, no evidence shows that users can connect external MCP servers for Sprinto to call. The compliance-skills GitHub repo provides skills for other agents to install, and inbound webhooks and integrations are adjacent features, not MCP client support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
